name: ACD-CHP-Sim
description: "ACD-CHP-Sim is a benchmark for evaluating autonomous cyber-defense configurations under adaptive adversarial conditions. The release contains 600 seeded spanning five scenarios\u2014adaptive malware propagation, AI-mediated deception, zero-day exploitation, denial-of-trust behavior, and cascading service failure\u2014and four defense configurations: Static IDS, RL Defense, Zero Trust, and a combined trust-aware multi-agent defense configuration (SMACDF). Each run contains 240 time steps over 120 unamed hosts partitioned into five zones. The package includes executable Python simulation code, complete per-step event logs, run-level summaries, aggregate statistics with 95% confidence intervals, paired-effect comparisons, metric definitions, and publication-quality figures. Metrics are operationally defined from observable state transitions and include attack success rate, unauthorized execution rate, containment effectiveness, service availability, recovery time, detection precision\/recall, trust calibration Brier score, trust stability, and cascade fraction. The benchmark is intended for defensive research and reproducibility. It contains no live malware, exploit payloads, credentials, or production network data."
